verdict.rationale: Convex offers an exit path: the backend is open source and can be self-hosted with the same code the cloud service runs, and paid plans include daily backups. However, the pack never documents an actual data-export command or the format of that data; it shows only `npx convex import`, and public HTTP endpoints for calling functions could serve at best as a manual extraction workaround. Missing for 10: a documented export/snapshot command, evidence of open export formats (e.g., JSON/JSONL/CSV), a documented cloud-to-self-hosted migration path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full data export.
